scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.dev.jsonc
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run db:local && wrangler dev --config wrangler.dev.jsonc
scripts.deploy: python3 require_branch.py main && npm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run && npm run db:remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:staging: python3 require_branch.py dev && npm run build && npm run check:staging && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.dev.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.dev.jsonc
